scripts.info: echo 'AM Core Services Monorepo' && echo 'Layers: libraries, domain, services'
scripts.run:gateway: npx -y dotenv-cli -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-gateway -s maven-settings.xml
scripts.run:analysis: npx -y dotenv-cli -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-analysis -s maven-settings.xml
scripts.run:mcp: npx -y dotenv-cli -- mvn spring-boot:run -pl services/am-mcp-server -s maven-settings.xml
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n "gateway,analysis,mcp" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run run:gateway" "npm run run:analysis" "npm run run:mcp"
